title: Government orders blocking of 7,393 links involved in film piracy

The legal framework against online film piracy has been strengthened by the government.

The injustice stemmed from the trial court's flawed evidence analysis, compounded by the High Court's refusal to entertain his delayed appeal. The Supreme Court emphasized how marginalized communities often find access to justice frustratingly elusive, shedding light on the pressing issues within the judicial system that disproportionately affect the underprivileged.

title: Trai unveils draft service quality norms for network slicing
description: Indian telecom consumers may soon see network slicing come to life, as the telecom authority has released draft protocols for this groundbreaking technology. These anticipated regulations will enable different internet speeds tailored to various user segments, allowing telecom operators to set unique prices for services like 4G and 5G. This development follows appeals from prominent telecom service providers.

title: 'Respect senior players': Rahane warns Gambhir amid India's Test struggles

title: Supreme Court urges states to decide on raising retirement age of judges by Sept 2
description: The Supreme Court urged states to decide on raising trial court judges' retirement age. This move aims to align their superannuation age with that of High Court judges. States were asked to make this decision by September 2, dismissing financial constraint arguments. The court stated that retaining experienced judges offers financial benefits to the government. High Courts were also requested to support this age enhancement initiative.

title: Ex-Ethiopian Air chief Tewolde Gebremariam becomes Air India CEO
description: Air India has appointed Tewolde Gebremariam as its new CEO and MD. He previously led Ethiopian Airlines for over 36 years, achieving significant growth. Gebremariam will succeed Campbell Wilson, who stabilized the airline initially. The Tata Group aims for profitable expansion and operational excellence under his leadership. Gebremariam expressed excitement about building a world-class global airline for India.

title: Deal on Hormuz shipping route reached with Oman, says Iran
description: Iran and Oman have agreed on a proposed shipping route through the Strait of Hormuz. This agreement is a potential step toward reopening the critical waterway for energy supplies. A joint statement from Tehran and Muscat is currently in the final drafting stage. Sources indicate Iran would gain control over ships entering the Gulf via the strait. Talks continue, but finalization depends on third-party non-obstruction and detailed definitions.

description: A hefty four-tonne piece from a SpaceX rocket has made its way to the moon, crashing after an eighteen-month journey in the cosmos. This second stage of the rocket hit the western limb at Einstein crater with considerable force. Currently, lunar satellites are on standby to document the impact and examine the debris. Meanwhile, conversations are underway between NASA and SpaceX to address the risk of future impacts.

Consumers already bearing UPI costs indirectly: RBI governor
description: RBI governor Sanjay Malhotra emphasized that the costs of UPI transactions are already subtly included in operations. He expressed it is premature to introduce explicit fees for merchants. The priority lies in enhancing the payment infrastructure and increasing utilization. Any fee implementation should consider potential effects on user engagement and ongoing investment, as consumers do indirectly incur costs, albeit often unnoticed.

title: Meet Brock Lesnar's family: Wife Sable, children, parents and siblings
description: Brock Lesnar, the WWE legend, leads a private family life with his wife Sable.  They share two sons, Turk and Duke, who play competitive hockey.  Lesnar also has twins, Mya and Luke, from a previous relationship.  Mya excels in college shot put while Luke wrestles competitively.  Raised on a South Dakota dairy farm, Lesnar credits his parents for his strong work ethic.

title: Meet Seungah Chung, who used 200 ants to reveal how they navigate
description: A bright young student embarked on a fascinating ant navigation experiment fueled by her natural curiosity. Through her meticulous research, she uncovered that ants primarily depend on visual markers for navigation. This groundbreaking project garnered her acclaim at a well-regarded science competition, showcasing the potential of such findings to inspire the development of innovative robots and autonomous systems.

How Travis Kelce is transforming lives beyond football in Kansas City
description: Kansas City Chiefs star Travis Kelce supports local children and families. He partnered with Kodiak to provide twenty-five thousand hot meals. Kelce also invested in Operation Breakthrough, a Kansas City nonprofit. His Eighty-Seven & Running Foundation supports youth programs and career exploration. This initiative offers practical skills and a safe space for students.

title: Kazakhstan releases first wild tiger in 70 years after extinction
description: Kazakhstan has released adult Amur tigers into the wild after a 70-year absence.  This reintroduction follows extensive habitat preparation and prey population restoration efforts.  Scientists confirmed the genetic similarity between extinct Turanian and current Amur tiger populations.  The country has implemented a comprehensive conflict-prevention system for human-tiger coexistence.  This significant conservation initiative aims to re-establish tigers in their historic Central Asian range.

title: Priscilla Chan founded a school in 2016; 10 yrs later, it closed after $125m funding
description: The Primary School, a tuition-free institution, will close in June after a decade of operation. This school provided education, healthcare, and family support to low-income children. The Chan Zuckerberg Initiative will not continue funding beyond the upcoming academic year. Academic results remained below state averages, prompting the board's decision. The initiative pledged fifty million dollars to aid the transition for affected students.

title: OpenAI's Greg Brockman gives millions to save eagles Jackie and Shadow's home
description: Greg Brockman and his wife Anna donated five point five million dollars to save shoreline forest.  This significant contribution helped secure ten million dollars for land conservation efforts.  The land, which is home to rare species, will now be protected from development.  Over twenty-five thousand small donors also contributed to the successful fundraising campaign.  Meanwhile, the eagle matriarch Jackie faces an uncertain health prognosis.

title: How Cristiano Ronaldo overcame poverty and loss to become a football legend
description: Cristiano Ronaldo’s journey is about much more than football. From growing up in poverty and leaving home at 12 to losing his father before achieving global success, every challenge shaped the player he became. His story reminds people that discipline, sacrifice and love for family can help overcome even the hardest moments and turn dreams into reality.
